tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: List the court cases this connector holds: id, caption, cause number, court, status and the incident each concerns. Pass an id as `case` to search, get_case_overview, list_case_topics and list_record_limitations. Every page id returned by search names its case.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the court record for case facts, testimony, positions, rulings, and jury findings. Call this for every case-specific factual question, then call fetch on relevant result IDs before answering. Each result says whether the page is in the reviewed evidence ledger and which classification it carr

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one search result's exact physical PDF page, reviewed evidence, provenance, and permanent citation URL. Use the returned classification and filename/page citation in the answer.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Find every page whose extracted text contains an exact phrase, whole word or regular expression - for a quotation, a dollar figure, a cause or exhibit number, a name or a defined term, where search ranks by meaning and may miss the exact words. Returns the total count, counts per filing, and each ma

tools.name: get_case_overview
tools.description: Return a concise, reviewed orientation to one case with evidence classifications and page citations. Use for first-time users, then search and fetch before answering detailed questions. `case` is a case id from list_cases.

tools.name: list_case_topics
tools.description: List the evidence topics covered for one case and suggested questions. Use when the user asks what the connector knows or what they should investigate. `case` is a case id from list_cases.

tools.name: list_record_limitations
tools.description: List what one case's reviewed record does NOT establish: unavailable filings, facts the evidence does not verify, review scope, and the legal status a document can and cannot prove. Call before asserting the record establishes something, and before answering a question the search results do not squa

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
